declaration.preface: OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD, incorporated on February 10, 2006, is dedicated to designing and manufacturing hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic steering systems for off-highway vehicles, automotive, and marine applications. We are committed to environmental stewardship, ensuring that our operations and products contribute positively to sustainability. We are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. As part of our dedication to sustainability and responsible business practices, we emphasize the importance of preventing corruption and ensuring responsible information management. This policy reflects our commitment to integrity, transparency, and accountability in all aspects of our business operations.
declaration.declaration: Ognibene India Pvt Ltd is committed to the highest ethical standards, prohibiting any form of corruption, bribery, or unethical behavior. We prevent conflicts of interest, fraud, and money laundering, ensuring integrity in all transactions. Our company promotes fair competition and safeguards the secure collection, processing, and storage of third-party information. By fostering transparency and accountability, we ensure ethical practices across all our business operations.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all workers, employees, directors, officers, agents, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD. It covers all business activities, including procurement, sales, marketing, and any interactions with government officials, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. The policy is applicable globally, regardless of local business practices or cultural norms.

Corruption Prevention: We aim for 100% compliance with anti-corruption training for all employees by the end of 2030 and will conduct annual audits in 100% of high-risk departments to identify and mitigate any corruption risks by 2030. We aim to conduct risk assessments at all sites and reduce corruption incidents by 100% by 2030 through enhanced monitoring and reporting systems.
Report any suspicious activities, unethical conduct, or bribery attempts to the Compliance Officer immediately.
Maintain clear, complete, and transparent records of all business and financial transactions.
Adhere to all anti-corruption and fraud prevention training and compliance requirements.
Politely refuse any gifts, cash, or favors that may influence business judgment or decision-making.
Do not offer, solicit, or accept bribes, kickbacks, or any form of improper advantage.
Do not falsify, conceal, or manipulate financial or operational records.
Do not engage in fraudulent business activities or misrepresentation.
Do not ignore or conceal any known or suspected corruption or fraud risks.
Conflict of Interest Management: All employees will be required to disclose any potential conflicts of interest annually, with the goal of achieving 100% compliance by 2030 and ensuring zero unresolved conflict of interest cases through prompt and effective resolution. We aim for 100% of employees to complete conflict of interest training by 2030, ensuring timely resolution of all reported conflicts.
Disclose promptly any personal, family, or financial interests that could influence professional decisions.
Seek written approval before engaging in any external business activity related to Ognibene India’s operations.
Follow established company procedures for reporting and resolving conflicts of interest.
Do not participate in decisions that personally benefit you or a related party.
Do not engage in business with direct competitors or vendors without formal authorization.
Do not use company resources or information for personal benefit.
Fraud Prevention: We maintain zero fraud incidents by 2030 and We aim for 100% of finance and procurement employees to complete specialized fraud prevention training annually by 2030. We Maintain zero fraud incidents by 2030, implementing quarterly fraud monitoring reports across all departments.
Money Laundering Prevention: We will maintain 100% compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations through comprehensive training for all relevant employees by 2030 and conduct due diligence checks on 100% of new suppliers and partners to ensure compliance with AML laws by 2030 and 100% of relevant employees to receive annual AML refresher training.
Report any suspicious or unusual transactions to the Compliance or Finance Department.
Conduct due diligence and background checks before engaging with new clients, partners, or suppliers.
Maintain accurate and traceable financial records for every transaction.
Do not approve or execute transactions without a clear business rationale.
Do not ignore warning signs of potential money laundering activities.
Do not structure transactions to avoid legal or regulatory reporting obligations.
Fair Competition: By 2030, we aim to ensure that 100% of business agreements comply with fair competition regulations through annual competition law audits. We aim for 100% of commercial employees to complete annual fair competition workshops by 2030, and maintain zero anti-competitive cases.
Compete fairly and ethically in all business activities.
Follow all applicable fair trade, competition, and antitrust laws.
Maintain transparency and honesty during contract negotiations and pricing discussions.
Do not engage in price-fixing, bid-rigging, or market allocation schemes.
Do not exchange or discuss pricing strategies, costs, or market-sensitive data with competitors.
Do not misuse Ognibene India’s market influence to unfairly restrict competition.
Information Security: We maintain 100% compliance with data protection laws by 2030 by enhancing cybersecurity measures, securing the collection, processing, and storage of third-party data, and conducting quarterly security audits with a target of zero data breaches by 2030. We aim to conduct risk assessments at all sites and reduce data breaches by 95% by 2030, while 100% of employees complete cybersecurity awareness training.
Follow all company cybersecurity and data protection protocols.
Use strong, unique passwords and enable multi-factor authentication where applicable.
Report phishing attempts, data breaches, or suspicious emails immediately to the IT Department.
Do not share confidential or proprietary information with unauthorized individuals.
Do not use personal devices to store or transmit company-sensitive data.
Do not click on unknown or suspicious links from unverified sources.
Anti-Bribery Practices: Ognibene India will uphold a zero-tolerance policy for bribery, ensuring that 100% of employees are trained on anti-bribery policies by the end of 2030, with annual reviews of business practices to ensure compliance with anti-bribery regulations.
Ethical Supplier Engagement: We aim to assess 100% of suppliers for ethical business practices by 2030 through annual evaluations and implement a supplier code of conduct to ensure alignment with the company’s ethics policies.
Community engagement: Ognibene India committed to engaging with and supporting the communities in which we operate, we aim for 60% increase in community engagement initiatives by 2030, including 100 volunteer hours annually and 2 supported projects per year.

responsibilities.duty: Responsible for overseeing the implementation, monitoring, and enforcement of this Ethics Policy, ensuring that all employees, contractors, suppliers, and third-party associates adhere to the defined ethical standards through regular training, internal audits, and reporting to senior management.
Provides strategic oversight and ensures ethical governance across all operations.
Leads execution and coordination with relevant departments.
Accountable for aligning daily operations with ethical standards.
Integrates compliance principles into recruitment and performance processes.
Uphold financial integrity and responsible sourcing.
Safeguards company and stakeholder data in line with legal requirements.
Share collective responsibility for maintaining integrity, promptly reporting violations, and fostering a culture of transparency, accountability, and ethical business conduct.

policy.monitoring:
The Compliance Manager at Ognibene India Pvt Ltd is responsible for overseeing the implementation, monitoring, and enforcement of this Ethics Policy, ensuring that all employees, contractors, suppliers, and third-party associates adhere to the defined ethical standards through regular training, internal audits, and reporting to senior management.

The Compliance Office will review this policy Bi-annually to ensure its effectiveness and relevance. This officer will assess any changes in the business environment, regulatory landscape, or internal practices that may necessitate updates to the policy.
